metadata.title: Business question → chart mapping
metadata.subtitle: Pick the chart from the question, not the other way around.

dataPoints.question: How is one numeric variable distributed?
Which category is largest?
dataPoints.use_when: Comparing values across a small set of categories

dataPoints.question: How does a metric change over time?
How do two numeric variables relate?
Where is performance highest?
dataPoints.use_when: Geographic differences are part of the story

dataPoints.question: Where do users drop off?
dataPoints.use_when: Conversion across a fixed sequence of stages

dataPoints.question: What changed between two periods?
dataPoints.use_when: Two snapshots, want to see direction and magnitude of change

dataPoints.question: Two breakdowns of the same metric?
dataPoints.use_when: Composition matters more than absolute values

dataPoints.question: Movement over time, broken by group?
dataPoints.use_when: 3+ series; small multiples if the comparison is the story
